主要内容: DBRS has released a report on Granite Real Estate Investment Trust, providing further details on the recent confirmation of the rating of Granite’s Senior Unsecured Debentures at BBB with a Stable trend. The report and the April 30, 2013, press release are available at www.dbrs.com or by contacting the organization at [email protected]. The report highlights insights on credit risk and evolving trends across private credit markets. Analysts Lisa Wu and Mark Newman are associated with the report, offering in-depth analysis on real estate and global corporate sectors.
